name: 英国技术工人签证
summary: 面向获得获批英国雇主担保、从事合资格工作并满足相应工资和英语要求的人士。
summaryEn: For people sponsored by an approved UK employer for an eligible job who meet the applicable salary and English requirements.

jobOffer.summary: 申请前须有确认的英国工作邀请，并取得雇主签发的担保证明。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A confirmed UK job offer and certificate of sponsorship from the employer are required before applying.

sponsorship.summary: 雇主须获英国内政部批准担保该路线。
sponsorship.summaryEn: The employer must be approved by the Home Office to sponsor this route.

occupation.summary: 岗位的四位职业代码须符合路线要求；部分中等技能岗位仅在指定清单或过渡情形下合资格。
occupation.summaryEn: The job's four-digit occupation code must qualify; some medium-skilled roles qualify only through specified lists or transitional cases.

salary.summary: 工资须达到适用于该岗位和申请情形的门槛；通常标准与职业现行工资取较高者，部分情形另有规则。
salary.summaryEn: Pay must meet the threshold applicable to the role and circumstances; the usual test uses the higher of a general threshold and the occupation's going rate, with separate rules for some cases.

english.summary: 通常须以认可方式证明英语听说读写能力；首次申请现行一般标准为 CEFR B2，豁免及过渡规则可能适用。
english.summaryEn: English in reading, writing, speaking and listening normally must be proved by an accepted route; the current general standard for a first application is CEFR B2, subject to exemptions and transitional rules.

sources.title: Skilled Worker visa — Knowledge of English

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
